test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a = 3 + sqrt{2}, b = 3 - sqrt{2} , then what is the value of a² + b² ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For conjugates a = x + √y and b = x − √y, the sum of squares is given by 2(x² + y).

Here x = 3 and √y = √2 ⇒ y = 2.

Calculation: 2 × (3² + 2) = 2 × (9 + 2) = 2 × 11 = 22.

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: a = 3 + √2 and b = 3 − √2

Formula: (x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy and (x − y)² = x² + y² − 2xy

⇒ a² = (3 + √2)² = 3² + (√2)² + 2 × 3 × √2 ⇒ a² = 9 + 2 + 6√2 = 11 + 6√2 ⇒ b² = (3 − √2)² = 3² + (√2)² − 2 × 3 × √2 ⇒ b² = 9 + 2 − 6√2 = 11 − 6√2 ⇒ a² + b² = (11 + 6√2) + (11 − 6√2) ⇒ a² + b² = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares Identity

For any two numbers, (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²). This is useful for solving symmetric expressions.

Rationalization Conjugates

The product of conjugates (x + √y)(x − √y) = x² − y is always a rational number.

Algebraic Expansion

Square of a binomial: (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.
